ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set residency table (fall 2025): applicants 6,171 in-state / 1,018 out-of-state / 167 international (7,356 total); admits 5,110 / 851 / 57 (6,018); enrolled 885 / 119 / 10 (1,014). International applicants were admitted at a much lower rate than the total (57 of 167). The Common Data Set rows split by sex show only 6,171 applicants and 5,110 admits, so the residency table totals are shown. Undergraduate enrollment 4,289 is the Common Data Set 'Total all undergraduates' figure (fall 2025); the 14:1 ratio is also from the Common Data Set. Winthrop reports a high school GPA average of 3.99 and a GPA breakdown whose alignment could not be read reliably, so GPA fields are not shown. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-year students. The Common Data Set's admission factor checkboxes contradict its test policy answer (test scores marked very important yet not used), so the factors are not shown.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set: 'We are test-optional for 2026-27 academic year. Decision has not been made for Fall 2027 admits.' It also marks SAT/ACT as not considered for admission.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set (2025-26): in-state tuition $11,130, out-of-state $25,170, required fees $3,550, on-campus food and housing $14,112. Estimated expenses for residents: books $1,200, transportation $2,702 and other expenses $4,168. 61 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid (average $24,492; total $1,494,033); whether it was need-based or non-need-based could not be read
